scenes.caption: Metros went from 5 cities to 26. Do the trains fill?
scenes.narration: India's metro network has grown enormously. But do the trains fill?

scenes.kicker: Operational metro and RRTS network, PIB
scenes.label: 2014 to 2025, and from 5 cities to 26
scenes.narration: In twenty fourteen, five cities had two hundred forty eight kilometres of metro. By twenty twenty five, twenty six cities had about one thousand ninety five.

scenes.title: Chennai Metro, daily riders (lakh)
scenes.caption: One city, one line set. Not the whole country.
scenes.narration: But in Chennai, the project report expected fifteen point six nine lakh riders a day by twenty twenty six. The reported figure is three point one four lakh, about a fifth.

scenes.caption: We found no comparable forecast for Delhi, so we don't claim it met its target.
scenes.narration: One city is not the country. We found no comparable forecast for Delhi, so we make no claim either way.
